title: Cut-Polytopes, Boolean Quadric Polytopes and Nonnegative Quadratic Pseudo-Boolean Functions
authors: Boros, Endre and Hammer, Peter L.
relevance: Omitted direct predecessor cited secondhand in the note: establishes the cut/BQP/nonnegative quadratic pseudo-Boolean correspondence and reports polynomial separation for specialized large facet subclasses. Its abstract does not establish polynomial separation of the full hypermetric or Boros–Hammer families; reading the full paper would delimit the subclasses precisely.

title: Generalised 2-circulant inequalities for the max-cut problem
authors: Kaparis, Konstantinos and Letchford, Adam N. and Mourtos, Ioannis
relevance: Gives an exact O(n^5) separator for generalized and extended generalized 2-circulant facet inequalities, a structured cut-polytope family. This does not settle full hypermetric, gap-1, rounded-PSD, hypermetric-correlation, or Boros–Hammer separation, but updates the map of exact polynomially separable subclasses.

title: Solving SDP relaxations of Max-Cut problem with large number of hypermetric inequalities by L-BFGS-B
relevance: Peer-reviewed computational study that strengthens the max-cut SDP with a subset of hypermetric inequalities and explicitly uses heuristic separation. It provides solver evidence, not an exact full-class oracle or a separation-complexity result.
